SELECTED_INDEX: 5
CONFIDENCE: 0.78
EXPLANATION: The very intense band at 901 cm⁻¹ with a companion at 859 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of an O–O stretch in a peroxide/1,2-dioxolane-type ring (supported by peroxide O–O bands ~860–900 cm⁻¹; see GFQ-069, GFQ-055). Candidate 5 uniquely contains an O–O bond (cyclic peroxy carbonyl). The strong carbonyl band at 1769 cm⁻¹ matches a high-frequency C=O typical for cyclic carbonate/peroxycarboxylate systems, higher than simple esters and lower than acyl fluorides/chlorides. Aliphatic C–H stretch at 2968 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1450 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), plus C–O-related bands at 1083, 1192, and 1255 cm⁻¹, further support an O-rich cyclic structure.
